dossier.scp_unleashed.082.title: Fernand the Cannibal
dossier.scp_unleashed.082.caption: SCP-082 as first sighted, in broad daylight on a river bank.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-082 is to be held in a large humanoid cell of the strongest construction available. Ordinary masonry is not adequate. %rAn earlier cell of stone and timber did not survive a lean week.%r
SCP-082 is fed on a fixed schedule. **Food is to be delivered from outside the cell. No member of staff is to enter the cell, come within arm's reach, or hand SCP-082 anything directly.**
SCP-082 talks constantly and is to be humoured. Staff are not to accept any invitation to dine.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-082 is a humanoid male nearly three metres tall, of heavy, ogre-like build, with broad shoulders, a pot belly, oversized hands and a heavy jaw set with large square teeth. He wears the court dress of an earlier age: a long blue coat trimmed in gold, a brocade waistcoat, lace at the throat and wrists, breeches, white stockings, red-heeled buckled shoes and a great powdered wig. Every seam is strained or split.
SCP-082 calls himself Fernand. He speaks of a kingdom, a court and a great many banquets, none of which can be traced. While well fed he is theatrical, courteous and cheerful.

SCP-082 must eat. His temper follows his appetite: as hunger grows he becomes irritable, then openly predatory. He seizes people bodily, lifts them in one hand and eats them. %rHe has shown no preference between staff, D-Class and civilians.%r
SCP-082 is extremely durable and recovers quickly after a meal.

page.title: Addendum 082-1: Recovery
text: SCP-082 was first encountered in daylight, sitting on a river bank and talking to the water. He greeted the recovery team warmly and invited them all to lunch. %rNot every member declined.%r
He has since been found only by day, near rivers and beaches, and only after this file has been opened.

page.title: Addendum 082-2: Incident Report
text: After a delivery was missed, SCP-082 grew restless, then furious. He beat at the walls of his cell for several minutes, roaring and stamping, and broke through two of them. %rThe third held.%r
Once fed, he apologised to staff for his manners and asked after the weather.

message.scp_unleashed.scp082.refuses: The controller cannot get a word in over SCP-082's appetite
SCP-082, "Fernand": a towering, ogre-like man in torn French court dress and a powdered wig. Keter-class. He talks without pause to anyone within earshot.
His hunger meter runs from 0 to 100 and slowly falls. Well fed, he is jovial, strolls about and leaves people alone. As it falls he grows irritable, then violent.
When hungry he hunts people: D-Class, villagers and players. He lifts a victim off their feet in one enormous hand, holds them a moment, then eats them.
Kept hungry for too long, he flies into rages, roaring, stamping and tearing at the walls around him. Ordinary masonry does not hold him for long.
He has %s health and heavy armour, and crushes anything he cannot pick up with a slam of his fists.
He does not occur naturally. Once his file has been read, he may be found by daylight, somewhere along a river bank or a beach.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp082.spawn.fail: There is no room for SCP-082 there.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp082.hunger.set: Set the hunger of %s SCP-082 to %s (%s).
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp082.0: A giant in court dress was seen by the water.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp082.1: Sightings come by day, on river banks and beaches.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp082.2: Do not accept his invitation to dine.
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.jovi: Bonjour, bonjour! Do come closer, I so rarely receive visitors who stay.
What splendid weather! In my kingdom the sun was not permitted to set before dessert.
Have you dined? No? Tragique. A guest should never go hungry in my presence.
Look at these cuffs. Finest lace in all the land. Slightly stretched, but finest.
My court musicians played until dawn. I do miss them terribly. Such fine company.
The river sings today. Listen! It hums like a soup about to boil.
A king must never skip dessert. It is in the constitution. I wrote it myself.
Ah, the clouds look like soufflés. Rising, rising... and then, pouf! Collapsing.
I once held a banquet that lasted eleven days. The twelfth day we do not discuss.
Mon ami, you have the posture of a courtier. Shoulders back! Chin up! Magnifique.
My wig? Powdered every morning, without fail. A gentleman keeps his standards.
Do you dance? I danced the gavotte once, and the floor never recovered.
The secret to a good sauce is patience. The secret to a good king is appetite.
In my kingdom we had a minister of cheese. Ah, he was a very serious man.
Sit, sit! The grass is a fine carpet and the sky an even finer ceiling.
My buttons? Merely decorative now. They gave up long ago, brave little things.
I adore company. Company is the bread of the soul. Bread is also the bread of the soul.
Every guest at my table left with a full heart. Well. Most of them left.
Behold the water, how it glitters! Like a thousand tiny chandeliers.
Ha! You look at me as though I were a giant. I am merely well fed.
I keep a little kingdom in my memory. The roads are paved with pastry.
Oh, what a pleasant afternoon. One could almost forget about luncheon.
My tailor wept when he last saw me. Tears of joy, I am certain.
Mon Dieu, the birds! Such small, cheerful creatures. Hardly a mouthful. I jest! I jest.
You must visit my palace one day. Bring friends. Bring many friends.
A toast! To the weather, to the river, and to whatever is for supper.
In the old days the trumpets announced me. Now the floorboards do it for me.
I never forget a face. I never forget a meal either. They are often the same.
There is no trouble in this world that a nine-course dinner cannot improve.
The ladies of the court admired my calves. Look at them! Still magnificent.
Ah, the scent of fresh air. Faintly of fish. Faintly of you. Charmant.
Have I told you of my coronation? Seven roasts and a fountain of gravy.
Do not be shy, petit. I am a gentleman of the most refined appetites.
When I am content, the whole world is content. Let us keep it that way, oui?
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.irri: Is it supper yet? It feels as though it ought to be supper.
My stomach is composing an overture. A grim one, in a minor key.
You there. You look well rested. Plump, even. No offence intended.
The service in this kingdom has become simply dreadful.
I asked for a feast and was given... silence. Silence is not a course.
Do not stand so close, mon ami. It gives me ideas.
Patience is a virtue. I have run out of virtues today.
Where is my steward? Where is anyone with a tray?
Hmph. Fish have no conversation, and less flavour.
When did I last dine? Yesterday? Last week? The days grow so long.
That is a very nice hat. It would look nicer with a sauce.
I am being perfectly polite. Note that. Remember it later.
A king should not have to ask twice for his luncheon.
My buttons are complaining less these days. That is a bad sign.
The weather is fine. The company is fine. The menu is empty.
Run along, petit. Before I remember what time it is.
I can hear your heartbeat. Very regular. Like a dinner bell.
Do they not feed royalty here? Is this a republic?
Forgive my temper. Hunger makes a poor courtier of me.
One small snack. That is all I ask. One small, walking snack.
Stop fidgeting. Fidgeting is how one ends up on the menu.
There was a time I was famous for my generosity. It was after lunch.
Your shadow is very large today. Much like my appetite.
Do you smell that? No? It is my patience, burning.
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.rave: Come here, mon petit. I only wish to look at you more closely.
The kingdom is starving, and the king is first among them.
Do not run. Running only stirs the appetite.
I can smell supper. It is wearing boots.
You would make a fine first course. A fine one indeed.
Sit down at my table. You are the guest of honour. And the roast.
Hold still! A gentleman does not chase his food. Normally.
I see you behind that wall, petit. I see you very well.
The banquet hall is open. Your attendance is... required.
Oh, do not be afraid. Fear spoils the flavour.
My hands are so very empty. Come and fill them.
Bon appétit, I say. To myself. Mostly to myself.
Every guest must taste the house speciality. Today, it is you.
I have waited so politely. Politeness is over.
Such a nice plump guest. Come, come, come...
Hiding? How charming. Like a little pastry in a box.
I will be quick. A king does not dawdle over the appetiser.
You hear that rumble? That is the dinner bell. It rings for you.
There is room at my table. There is always room.
The menu has one item, and it is walking away. Not for long.
Do not make me come over there. I am already coming over there.
Supper! Supper! Who will be my supper?
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.star: Where is the FEAST? I was PROMISED a feast!
Hungry... so very hungry... the walls look like bread.
I will eat the table, the chairs, the curtains, ANYTHING!
My kingdom for a meal! MY KINGDOM!
Can you hear it? My stomach is roaring louder than I am.
Nothing left. Nothing! Not one crumb in the whole kingdom!
Who locked the pantry? WHO LOCKED THE PANTRY?
I am fading... a king should not fade... FEED ME.
Starving! The king is STARVING! Is anyone listening?
Stone and silence. Stone and silence and no supper.
I will chew through the very floor if I must.
The banquet must begin. It MUST begin. NOW.
Do not leave me here with nothing! NOTHING!
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.grab: Got you, mon petit! What a catch!
Up you come! Let me have a look at you.
Hello, hello! Such a fine guest you are.
There we are. Do not squirm, it is unbecoming.
Welcome to my table. You will be staying for supper.
Such a light little thing. Hardly a snack. But a snack!
Hush now. A guest should not shout at the host.
Look at you, all wriggly. Delightful.
Steady, steady. The king has you.
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.meal: Magnifique! My compliments to the chef. That is me.
Ahh. That was a fine course. Is there dessert?
Delicious. Simply delicious. Who is next? I jest.
Ooh, that hit the spot. The kingdom is at peace once more.
Exquisite! A little chewy. But exquisite.
There. Much better. Where were we? Ah yes. The weather.
Merci, merci. A wonderful guest. Truly, they will be missed.
Mmm! I feel like a king again. Because I am one.
Now that is what I call a royal banquet.
Pardon me. A gentleman must loosen his belt after such a meal.
Oh, I could nap for a week. Perhaps only a day.
Superb. Have someone fetch the next course in a while.
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.snac: Hm! A morsel. A mere morsel. But a thoughtful one.
Ah, a gift! You are a generous subject.
Not bad. Not a feast, but not bad.
More of these, if you please. Many more.
Merci, petit. A little something for the royal stomach.
Delicious little crumbs. Bring the whole bakery next time.
Ah, a snack. The king approves. Mildly.
A fine offering. We shall remain friends, you and I.
Delightful. My stomach sends its regards.
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.rage: ENOUGH! If no one will bring the feast, I will FETCH it!
These walls cannot keep a king from his supper!
RAAAH! The kingdom is CLOSED for starvation!
I will tear this place down, stone by stone, crumb by crumb!
Out of my way, walls! The king is going to DINNER!
You starve your king? Then your king will come to YOU!
I smell you out there! I am coming through!
The banquet hall is wherever I make it!
Hunger! HUNGER! I will not be caged by HUNGER!
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.esca: Ow! You wriggled! How very rude.
Come back here! You have not been excused from the table!
Slippery little thing! I will remember your face.
Bah! My fingers are not what they were.
Fine, fine. Run. Supper always comes back around.
Ouch! Is that any way to treat your host?
Next time, mon petit. Next time.
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.jovi: Young Mozart played for me at supper once. Seven years old, and already he refused to stop for dessert.
Herr Mozart wrote a little minuet in my honour. He called it Allegro, ma non troppo affamato.
I told Wolfgang his symphony needed more drums. He laughed for an hour. I was not joking.
Mozart wrote in a letter that I hum off-key. I have never forgiven the boy.
The Sun King once asked how I kept my figure. I told him: ambition, and second helpings.
Louis lent me his best wig for a ball at Versailles. I returned it. Mostly.
Marie Antoinette and I agreed on everything except cake. She believed there could be too much of it.
Voltaire came to dinner and argued with the soup for an hour. The soup won.
I taught Empress Catherine a card game. She won my carriage and my second-best wig.
Handel conducted my birthday feast. The trumpets were so loud the pheasants surrendered.
Monsieur Franklin arrived at court with a kite and a terrible hat. I liked him at once.
Napoleon was shorter than me. Everyone was shorter than me. He took it very personally.
Casanova tried to charm my cook. My cook tried to charm him back, with a ladle.
Bach sent me a fugue by post. It took four horses to carry the sheet music.
Haydn asked me to sit very still during his Surprise Symphony. I did not. That was the surprise.
Beethoven could not hear my compliments, so I shouted them. He said that was worse.
The Duke of Orleans and I ate an entire orchard in one afternoon. Then we started on the gardeners' lunch.
An English queen once refused a seat at my table. She said I looked at the guests oddly. Imagine!
message.scp_unleashed.scp082.ramble.irri: Mozart never kept me waiting this long, and that boy was always late.
Even the Sun King fed his guests before he made them talk. Remember that.
I sat through three of Wagner's operas without supper. Do not test me.
Marie Antoinette would have offered me cake by now. You have offered nothing.
